newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Cricket-Rain reduces West Indies-WA match to 47 overs.
newsitem.headline: Cricket-Rain reduces West Indies-WA match to 47 overs.

text.p: Bad weather delayed the start of play in a limited overs match between West Indies and Western Australia on Wednesday.
Persistent rain forced umpires to reduce the match from a scheduled 50 overs to 47 overs per side. The start of play was also pushed back to 3.00 p.m. Western Australian time (6 p.m. AEDT).
Star batsman Brian Lara will lead the West Indians for the first time after tour captain Courtney Walsh chose to miss the match.
